title: When Plagiarism Costs Nothing, 'Original' Loses Its Meaning
title_zh: 当洗稿成本归零，「原创」就失去了定义
excerpt: AI rewrites can replicate 80% of an article's value while scoring 100% on originality checks. What happens when our definition of 'original' breaks down?
excerpt_zh: AI 改写可以零成本获取文章 80% 的价值，同时在检测系统眼中拥有 100% 的「原创性」。当「原创」的定义失效，我们该信任谁？
